note: Adapted from the species-level description in Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier has characters and measurements, the worker is recorded in the original only as having 15-segmented antennae and is not treated as a separate section; synonymy, figure numbers, localities and nesting records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Slightly smaller than A. latinotus. Compared with A. guineensis the body is smaller, the sides of the head less straight, the apical curvature of the mandibles weaker and the incision of the anterior pronotal margin shallower.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule sparsely covered with fine setae. Antennae 14–15-segmented; when 14-segmented, the third segment slightly longer than the second and the fourth slightly shorter than the second; when 15-segmented, the third segment shorter than the fourth and the fourth shorter than the second. Apices of the mandibles strongly incurved. Anterior margin of the pronotum deeply incised. Head length 1.89 mm, head width 1.10–1.20 mm; pronotum median length 0.50 mm, total length 0.60 mm, pronotum width 0.72–0.78 mm; hind tibia length 0.97–1.05 mm; left mandible length 0.80 mm. Minor soldier: antennae 14-segmented. Head length 1.44 mm, head width 0.78 mm; pronotum median length 0.33 mm, pronotum width 0.58 mm; hind tibia length 0.83 mm; left mandible length 0.67 mm.
